query: 供应商环境标准 供应商环境标准 衡量供应链环境准入标准与约束机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备系统的供应商环境准入标准（含碳足迹、排污等硬性指标）；实行动态环境分级管理，并根据分级结果执行差异化采购政策；有明确的违规处理机制（如红线淘汰制）。 • 1分（合格）：发布了供应商行为准则，包含基础的环境保护要求，具备初次准入的环境审核，但缺乏动态分级管理或明确的违规退出机制。 • 0分（不合格）：无供应商环境标准披露，或仅笼统提及“推行绿色采购”。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：已签署环境协议或执行环境标准的供应商数量（或采购额）占比 >80%。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对一级供应商/关键原材料供应商执行，或未披露具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 供应商环境标准 绿色采购 供应商行为准则 环境准入 供应商环境审核 分级管理 环境黑名单 供应商退出机制 supplier environmental standards green procurement supplier code of conduct environmental prequalification supplier environmental audit tiered supplier management environmental blacklist supplier exit mechanism 企业是否制定供应商环境准入标准？ 标准是否包含碳足迹、排污等硬性要求？ 是否实行动态环境分级管理与差异化采购？ 违规处理或红线淘汰机制是什么？ 已签署/执行标准的供应商数量或采购额占比是多少？

It ensures that premium-quality raw materials can be sourced at competitive prices, and the values of the selected supplier on environment, community and ethics are embraceable. All of the Group's suppliers are located in mainland China. There are about 10 major suppliers. During the Reporting Period, there were no material instances of non-compliance concerning the supply chain management.

results.text: The Group strictly abides by the laws and regulations of the PRC government, including the 'Labour Law' and the 'Labour Contract Law'. When the human resources department conducts recruitment work, it shall strictly verify the personal identity of the applicant and perform background checks well to avoid child labour. Employees at production bases are recruited of their own accord. The staff induction process is carried out in line with corporate systems and procedures where no child labour is employed. The ages of all employees satisfy the requirements of local laws. The phenomenon of forced labour does not exist. If any illegal employment of child labour or forced labour is discovered, the Group will immediately terminate the employment contract, identify the cause and pursue responsibility, and impose appropriate penalties on the employee and related person in violation.
